evidence_required: multi-row limit=1 continuation and complete-enumeration output
malformed, non-canonical, and wrong-Plant cursor 422 evidence
FT-005 focused and full regression summaries
purpose: Make the advertised FT-005 catalog pagination truthful so authorized clients can enumerate every PostgreSQL catalog row beyond limit through a stable opaque cursor.
success_outcome: FT-005 catalog pages use deterministic Plant-scoped keyset continuation, return a real next_cursor when more rows exist, and reject invalid cursors instead of ignoring them.
anti_goals: No photo upload, artifact layout, manifest, checksum, or timeline acceptance redesign.
No offset pagination, server-side cursor registry, or new pagination framework.
No rewrite of historical TASK-021 or TASK-022 lifecycle/evidence.

forbidden_scope: photo artifact acceptance or storage redesign
Plant history cursor or response changes
offset state or a server-side cursor registry
stop_conditions: The repair requires a database migration or new persistent cursor state.
Stable continuation cannot preserve the documented uploaded_at DESC, photo_id ASC order.
The repair requires changing upload/artifact identity or acceptance semantics.
Authorization cannot be resolved before catalog cursor results are returned.
Diagnostics or evidence contain secrets, auth material, absolute paths, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, or hidden reasoning.

constraints: Use stable keyset order uploaded_at DESC, photo_id ASC and fetch limit + 1 rows.
The canonical unpadded base64url v1 cursor contains Plant id plus the last returned uploaded_at/photo_id tuple and must round-trip exactly.
Malformed, non-canonical, wrong-version, invalid-field, and wrong-Plant cursors use existing 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.
Catalog reads remain PostgreSQL-authoritative and ActorContext-scoped; filesystem scanning is forbidden.
invariants: An unchanged catalog can be fully enumerated without duplicate or omitted rows.
next_cursor is null if and only if no row exists after the returned page.
A supplied cursor advances the keyset query or fails validation; it is never ignored.
Pagination does not weaken Plant/Farm authorization or expose cross-Plant existence.
verification_targets: Repeat the three-photo limit=1 continuation probe from the FT-005 feature red-verify report and enumerate all pages.
